pages.lines:
Our RV sites are located just steps from the shoreline of Trout Lake, offering easy access to the beach, fishing, and lake activities — without the density of large resorts.
We are primarily a seasonal RV community, with returning families who enjoy spending the entire summer on the lake. A limited number of sites are available for nightly and weekly stays throughout the season.
Whether you’re visiting for a weekend getaway or bringing your RV for an extended stay, you’ll find a quiet, respectful, family-friendly environment designed for relaxing lake days.
﻿
Limited nightly inventory — peak summer weekends book early.
Check RV Site Availability
What Guests are Saying...
"Campground offers seasonal sites, nightly RV sites and even rentable lakeside campers. Lake has a clear private beach. Multiple restrooms in all areas, a shower house and laundry room. Great family friendly environment. Store on site for snacks, ice cream. Firewood on site. Five Stars!"
Cameron A.
